intro: The Magnum jar proves that small storage can make a big difference. With a durable glass build and a freshness-locking lid, it keeps your spices and herbs perfectly organised and full of flavour.

features.title: Made from high-quality glass
features.text: Our jar is crafted from durable, food-safe glass, ensuring long-lasting use while keeping your ingredients fresh and safe.

features.title: Compact design for small storage needs
features.text: Our 93 ml size is perfect for spices, herbs, and small kitchen essentials, offering smart storage without taking up extra space.

features.title: Airtight lid to preserve freshness
features.text: Our secure-sealing lid locks in flavours and keeps moisture out, so every ingredient stays just as fresh as the day you bought it.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Magnum 93ml Jar
